mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_point_stats ( user_id, section_id, knowledge_point, total_count, correct_count, wrong_count, accuracy_rate, avg_time_spent, last_test_time, mastery_level, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sectionId}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{totalCount}, #{correctCount}, #{wrongCount}, #{accuracyRate}, #{avgTimeSpent}, #{lastTestTime}, #{masteryLevel}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_count = VALUES(total_count), correct_count = VALUES(correct_count), wrong_count = VALUES(wrong_count), accuracy_rate = VALUES(accuracy_rate), avg_time_spent = VALUES(avg_time_spent), last_test_time = VALUES(last_test_time), mastery_level = VALUES(mastery_level), update_time = NOW()
